description: Coastal Flooding Risk Index [experimental] is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment and Climate Change Canada | Environnement et Changement climatique Canada. The Costal Flooding Risk Index in GeoJSON format is a geo and time referenced polygon product issued by the Meteorological Service of Canada (MSC) to articulate the coastal flooding risk, impact and probability. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Environment and Climate Change Canada | Environnement et Changement climatique Canada. Its tags are Risk, Index, Probability, Storm surge, Wave impact. It offers 6 resource(s) in HTML, JSON. The portal shows 2025-10-15 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
